costume.name: Enchanted Jester
costume.description: Plum and sage velvet diamonds, a cream ruff, and a playful two-point cap create a soft theatrical look.
costume.alt: Plum and sage two-point jester cap, diamond-patterned velvet tunic, cream ruff, plum trousers, and curled dark boots

pieces.name: Purple and green jester cap
pieces.styleNotes: Soft pointed cap in purple and green. Available colors are brighter than the generated plum and sage; most higher-priced caps add points or colors. No verified ready-made cap matches the exact muted plum/sage colors and gold-trimmed diamond band.
queries: purple green two point velvet jester hat

matches.reason: Handmade in New Hampshire. Purple, green and gold fleece with three points, purple double-thick band and gold-tone bells. Live listing states 3 left and ready to ship. Extra gold panel and third point differ from the two-point reference.

Select Green/Purple. Two soft velvet points, black headband and bells. Real selected-color merchant photograph, 400×400. Live page shows the Green/Purple radio selected and an enabled Add to Bag button. Merchant gives no head measurement; confirm fit before ordering. Bright purple/lime green differs from plum/sage.

Black, purple, wine and green cotton velveteen with silver bells and adjustable elastic cord. Additional black/wine panels and multiple points differ from the plum/sage two-point cap. Live variant is available. Merchant says US and Canada orders ship once per week.

pieces.name: Purple theatrical tunic
pieces.styleNotes: DIY tunic base: cut and sew the separately listed sage or green felt into large contrasting diamonds on the body. The real purple garments do not include the diamonds, pointed bell hem or full generated trim. The velvet middle option is the closest fabric base. No verified finished plum/sage diamond-patterned velvet tunic was found. This catalog follows the design’s stated DIY route: buy the purple base and separate sage/green felt, then cut and sew diamonds. The pointed bell hem and gold diamond edging are not supplied. Ordinary scissors, needle and thread are needed.
queries: purple medieval tunic full sleeves buttons

matches.reason: One vintage Nina Piccalino tunic, listed large; original tag says size 10. Deep purple 90% polyester/10% spandex velvet, satin trim, faux covered front buttons, fitted long sleeves and side slits. Length 30 inches; bust flat 19 inches. Available in live feed. Seller states dispatch within 1–3 business days. No sage diamonds, puff sleeves or bell hem. DIY required: cut and sew diamonds from the separately listed sage/green felt onto the body. This garment alone is not the finished patterned jester tunic.

Purple 100% rayon top, 25-inch length, front buttons, embroidery and back tie. Merchant offers One Size and Plus Size at USD36.99; live size-level inventory is not exposed. Short sheer sleeves and floral embroidery differ substantially from the fitted velvet jester tunic. Sage diamonds, long sleeves and bell hem are not included. DIY required: cut and sew diamonds from the separately listed sage/green felt onto the body. This garment alone is not the finished patterned jester tunic.

Select Purple. Twill tunic with very full sleeves, slim body, front buttons and sleeve buttons. Only XSmal–XLarge cost USD92; 2XLarge–4XLarge cost USD97 and are excluded. These purple variants are available in the live feed; dispatch timing is not confirmed. Strong courtly silhouette, but no velvet, sage diamond panels or pointed bell hem. DIY required: cut and sew diamonds from the separately listed sage/green felt onto the body. This garment alone is not the finished patterned jester tunic.

pieces.name: Cream or white ruff collar
pieces.styleNotes: A full, separate ruff frames the face. The cream cotton collar is the closest color; other choices are white and change the texture. Only the budget ruff is cream. The middle option is made to order and carries explicit stock uncertainty.

matches.reason: Cream/off-white cotton ruff and cuffs, adjustable ties, cream overlocked edges. Collar depth 9 inches; cuffs 5 inches. Live listing states 3 left. Made in the USA and ships from Iowa. Gathered full ruffles rather than the reference crisp pleated lace-edged ruff.

Collar only. White cotton top/bottom layers; pink and purple satin middle layer with teal ribbon. Ribbon ties; longest depth 10 inches. Live listing accepts orders and states 3 left, but explicitly made to order; allow 5–8 days to make before dispatch. White and colored trim differ from the cream reference.

Select white. One polyester tulle mesh ruff collar with back fastening; no cuffs. Live white variant available. Large airy puff rather than cream pleated cotton. Merchant states 5–10 business days processing and tracked worldwide shipping; delivery timing is not promised.

pieces.name: Fitted plum or burgundy velvet trousers
pieces.styleNotes: Fitted velvet leggings recreate the narrow plum trouser line. These have no gold side piping; burgundy and purple are color approximations. None includes the generated gold piping. The mid-price option fits only XS.

matches.reason: Spanx Rich Burgundy velvet leggings. Only XS is available at USD49 in the live feed; S, M, L, XL and 1X are sold out and excluded. Burgundy rather than plum; no gold side trim. Boutique is in Aberdeen, South Dakota.

Burgundy stretch velvet leggings with elastic waist and semi-cropped length. All four listed sizes available in the live merchant feed. Wine/burgundy rather than plum, shorter than full trousers, and no gold piping. Boots can cover the cropped hem.

Select purple velvet. High-waisted fitted velvet leggings; all XS–XL purple variants available at USD81 in the US storefront feed. Purple is brighter than the reference plum. No gold side piping. Use merchant measurements; no size conversion is assumed.

pieces.name: Dark curled-toe boots
pieces.styleNotes: Choose real curled-toe footwear. The curl is built into these products, so separate soft toe covers are unnecessary; height and colors vary. Verified sizes are narrow at each price. These use built-in curved toes, not separate soft curled toe covers. The middle pair adds red panels.

pieces.name: Sage or green felt for DIY tunic diamonds
pieces.styleNotes: Cut large diamonds from the separately purchased felt. Sew them onto the purple tunic base to create the defining contrasting jester pattern. These are raw fabric supplies, not pre-cut appliqués or a finished tunic. Sage is closest; olive and dark green are explicit color alternatives. Fabric quantities differ by tier. More than the listed single cut may be needed. None includes pre-cut shapes, gold edging or the pointed bell hem. The selected tunic and felt require cutting and sewing.
